summary: Prototype rules, not a security certification. Local emulator: 6 passing tests against final source. Backend: 31 passing unit tests. Production rules unchanged. Standard emulator testing does not establish full Enterprise parity.

findings.issue: Prior rules allowed owner replacement to delete server-added profile fields.
findings.recommendation: Final local rules deny client update/delete. Owner bootstrap and read pass; truncation, cross-user access, extra fields, forged timestamps and protected collection access fail as expected.

findings.issue: Production rules, rate limits and real concurrent booking transactions remain unverified. New minimal program documents lack scheduling and capacity fields. Admin SDK bypasses Security Rules.
findings.recommendation: Review prototype rules and API authorization before public release. Verify booking sessions, limits, Enterprise behavior, rate limiting and budgets in staging.
